summary: Device searches answer in seconds, you can see long steps moving, and nights run steadier.

new.title: Device search answers in seconds
new.text: Searching for a device name, a CVE or an id in the detailed findings view now answers in seconds instead of 40 seconds or more. Searching anywhere in the text is still there.

new.title: Long steps show that they are moving
new.text: Large reports, the data sync and the building of configuration items now report how far they are, for example batch 161 of 266. You and support see that a long night is moving.

fixes.title: Brief network failures no longer slow nights
fixes.text: When a database connection failed for a moment, part of preparing the views was given up and the night ran slower. SecurityInsight now tries again a few times first.

fixes.title: Kept open is no longer counted as held
fixes.text: Findings kept open in your ticketing system until enough complete runs confirm they are gone are now counted on their own. What your ticketing system receives is unchanged.
